title: Thank You to Those Who Serve, Protect, Heal and Teach
summary: Mito thanks educators, first responders, healthcare workers, and military members and families with a membership offer. See who qualifies and how to claim.
body_markdown:
Table of contents


To everyone who serves, protects, heals and teaches: thank you. Starting on Veterans Day, Mito is saying thank you to educators, first responders, healthcare workers, and military members, veterans and their families with a membership offer.


To claim it, complete the short verification form at[mitohealth.com/heroes](https://mitohealth.com/heroes) . Once your eligibility is confirmed, we send you a code to use when you join. The full details and terms are on that page.


## Who qualifies


Mito’s thank-you is for four groups:


- **Military:** active duty, National Guard, reserve and veteran members of the US armed forces, plus the spouses and dependents of service members and veterans.
- **First responders:** police officers, firefighters, EMTs and paramedics.
- **Healthcare professionals:** nurses, physicians and other healthcare workers.
- **Educators.**


## What Mito Membership gives you


[Mito Membership](https://mitohealth.com/membership) is the plan that turns lab results into an ongoing picture of your health. It normally costs $9/month or $99/year, and it includes:


- **Member pricing** on lab tests, panels, scans and kits. On most lab tests, members pay about 28% less than non-members. A lab draw fee is charged per visit.
- **A personalized action plan** built from your results.
- **Longitudinal tracking** of your results over time, including past labs you upload.
- **Clinician review.** A Mito clinician reviews your results before your dashboard analysis is finalized.
- **Mito Concierge** , an AI health chat, with text-based escalation to the care team when a question needs clinical input.
- **Consults at member pricing:** $39 for members, compared with $99 for non-members.


Tests are bought a la carte, so you choose what to test and when. Lab tests, panels and scans bought through Mito are generally eligible for HSA and FSA payment. See[how Mito works](https://mitohealth.com/how-it-works) for the full path from ordering a test to reading your results.


## How to claim it


1. **Complete the verification form** at[mitohealth.com/heroes](https://mitohealth.com/heroes) .
2. **Get your code.** Once your eligibility is confirmed, we send you a code.
3. **Join Mito Membership** with your code.


If you know someone who qualifies, send them to[mitohealth.com/heroes](https://mitohealth.com/heroes) so they can verify and get their own code.


## Frequently asked questions


### Who qualifies for Mito's thank-you offer?


Educators; first responders, including police officers, firefighters, EMTs and paramedics; nurses, physicians and other healthcare workers; active duty, National Guard, reserve and veteran members of the US armed forces; and the spouses and dependents of service members and veterans.


### How do I claim it?


Complete the short verification form at mitohealth.com/heroes. Once your eligibility is confirmed, we send you a code to use when you join Mito Membership. The full details and terms are on that page.


### Can current Mito members use the offer?


No. The offer is for people joining Mito Membership for the first time. If you know someone who qualifies, send them to mitohealth.com/heroes.
